title: Revit Preflight Check Governed Fields

entries.name: Check identity
entries.requirement: Each governed preflight check shall have a stable identity so results can be traced across model states, issues, and automation runs.

entries.name: Check scope
entries.requirement: Each check shall identify the applicable model, views, sheets, elements, or output package being evaluated.

entries.name: Check domain
entries.requirement: Each check shall identify its governed domain, such as view/template state, sheet/titleblock state, annotation/tagging, naming/identity, parameters, worksharing, family/modeling hygiene, phasing/design options, output legibility, or another approved domain.

entries.name: Governing object
entries.requirement: Each check shall reference the standard, instruction, registry, or conformance object that defines the expected state.

entries.name: Implementation class
entries.requirement: Each check shall identify whether it is intended for API checking, model checking, registry checking, file/output checking, human verification, or an approved hybrid method.

entries.name: Applicability rule
entries.requirement: Each check shall state when it applies and when a not-applicable result is permitted.

entries.name: Expected evidence
entries.requirement: Each check shall identify the evidence required to support pass, fail, not-applicable, or indeterminate results.

entries.name: Result state
entries.requirement: Each execution shall record a governed result state rather than relying on an undocumented verbal conclusion.

entries.name: Deviation trace
entries.requirement: Any unresolved or accepted deviation shall be traceable to its rationale, owner, disposition, and governing exception path where applicable.

entries.name: Model-state reference
entries.requirement: The preflight result shall identify the model/container state, version, issue, or other reproducible state against which the checks were executed.

entries.name: Output evidence reference
entries.requirement: Where visual or plotted legibility is material, the check shall reference representative PDF, print, screenshot, or equivalent output evidence.

entries.name: Decision boundary
entries.requirement: The check definition shall state that preflight evidence does not by itself constitute coordination sign-off, contractual acceptance, or reliance authorization unless the governing S5/S7 authority explicitly assigns that decision.

non_promoted_source_content: No universal warning-count threshold is promoted because the source does not provide an approved enterprise value.
No universal purge-frequency, file-size, sync-frequency, model-open-time, or print-scale threshold is promoted where the source provides only examples or TODO values.
No QA result is promoted to formal acceptance authority merely by passing a preflight check.

provenance.source_title: Revit Style Guide - QA / Review Checklists
provenance.migration_note: Round 006 creates the machine-readable control fields needed to execute and evidence Appendix E Revit preflight checks while preserving the source's draft/style-focused scope and higher-level S5/S7 authority boundaries.
